title: BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the fiscal impact of raising the Small Business Exemption (SBE) thresholds to the City’s Business Tax.
text:
[Council File 25-1474]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the fiscal impact of raising the Small Business Exemption (SBE) thresholds to the City’s Business Tax.
Recommendation for Council action:
NOTE and FILE the Office of Finance reports dated October 20, 2026 and October 30, 2026, attached to the Council file, inasmuch as the reports are provided for informational purposes only.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Not applicable.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
